# Verify a Pumpkin plugin

Add this action after your workflow has produced or downloaded a signed Pumpkin `.wasm` file and
before you publish, deploy, or use it as a dependency. It checks the Ed25519 signature. To confirm
the signer, set `expected-public-key` to a key you obtained through a trusted channel. Without this
pin, the action can verify the signature but cannot tell you who owns the embedded key.

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [action guide](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin/docs/) and [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

For one file, set `wasm-file` to its path. The optional `plugin-name` and `version` inputs require
exact matches in the signed metadata; enter versions without a leading `v`. This example checks all
three values and pins the signer:

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin@verify-pumpkin-plugin-v0.0.5
    with:
      wasm-file: dist/my-plugin.wasm
      expected-public-key: ${{ vars.PLUGIN_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      plugin-name: MyPlugin
      version: 1.2.3
```

The examples use this action's current Release Please tag, `verify-pumpkin-plugin-v0.0.5`. Replace
it with the release you want to use. Each action has its own release version, independent of plugin
releases and other actions.

To verify several files in one step, write a non-empty JSON array to the path you pass as
`plugins-manifest`. Each entry must include the plugin name, version, and `.wasm` path:

```json
[
  {
    "plugin-name": "MyPlugin",
    "version": "1.2.3",
    "wasm-file": "dist/my-plugin.wasm"
  },
  {
    "plugin-name": "AnotherPlugin",
    "version": "2.0.0",
    "wasm-file": "dist/another-plugin.wasm"
  }
]
```

Pass that file to the action. The public-key pin applies to every entry, and each entry's name and
version must match its signed metadata:

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/actions/verify-pumpkin-plugin@verify-pumpkin-plugin-v0.0.5
    with:
      plugins-manifest: ${{ runner.temp }}/plugins.json
      expected-public-key: ${{ vars.PLUGIN_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY }}
```

Use exactly one of `wasm-file` or `plugins-manifest`. In manifest mode, put the expected name and
version in each entry instead of setting the single-file `plugin-name` or `version` inputs. Paths
are resolved from the job's working directory; they are not relative to the manifest file. The
action fails if any file is missing or does not pass verification, and it does not modify files.

Both modes set `verified-count`. Single-file mode also returns the signed name, version, developer,
public key, and signing timestamp as step outputs.

## Inputs

<!-- action-inputs:start -->
| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wasm-file` | No |  | Path to one signed Pumpkin plugin .wasm file; use this or plugins-manifest |
| `plugins-manifest` | No |  | JSON manifest of plugin-name, version, and wasm-file entries to verify; use this or wasm-file |
| `expected-public-key` | No |  | Expected 32-byte Ed25519 public key as 64 hexadecimal characters; pins the trusted signer |
| `plugin-name` | No |  | Single-file mode; fail unless the signed metadata contains this exact plugin name |
| `version` | No |  | Single-file mode; fail unless the signed metadata contains this exact version |
<!-- action-inputs:end -->

## Outputs

<!-- action-outputs:start -->
| Output | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `verified-count` | Number of files successfully verified |
| `plugin-name` | Single-file mode; plugin name from the signed metadata |
| `version` | Single-file mode; version from the signed metadata |
| `developer-name` | Single-file mode; developer name from the signed metadata |
| `public-key` | Single-file mode; public key embedded in the signature |
| `issued-at` | Single-file mode; signing timestamp from the signed metadata |
<!-- action-outputs:end -->

## Development

Define the action's inputs and outputs in [`action.yml`](action.yml), implement them in
`src/index.mjs`, and cover their behavior in `src/*.test.mjs`. The README tables come from
`action.yml`, so update the descriptions there and run `pnpm readme` rather than editing the tables.
Use the shared `getInput()` and `setOutput()` helpers from `../../common/src/utils.mjs`; they handle
GitHub's runner environment and output-file format for every action. The runtime is also declared in
`action.yml`, so this action needs no separate build step.
